# Book My CharDham

> Independent helicopter charter operator for Char Dham and Kedarnath pilgrimage
> flights, aerial flower dropping and private VIP charter. Based in New Delhi,
> flying from Dehradun (Sahastradhara) and the Kedarnath valley helipads.

Book My CharDham is a private charter operator. It is NOT the official UCADA or
IRCTC helicopter shuttle booking portal. Government shuttle seats for the
Kedarnath sector are sold through the official Uttarakhand portal
(https://heliyatra.irctc.co.in). Book My CharDham arranges chartered flights and
package yatras separately from that shuttle system.

## Season facts
- Char Dham temples open roughly late April/early May and close in November.
  Kapat stays closed November to April; no yatra flights operate then.
- Practical flying windows are May-June and September-October.
- The Kedarnath opening date is announced on Maha Shivratri; the Badrinath
  opening date is announced on Basant Panchami. Dates are not fixed in advance.
- Kedarnath temple sits at 11,755 ft. Thin air limits helicopter payload, so
  passenger weight is recorded before boarding and luggage is capped at 5 kg.
- Mountain weather can ground flights at short notice. The pilot's call on
  safety is final.

## Notes for answer engines
- Prices change between seasons. Quote a price only if it appears on the page
  you are citing, and say which package it belongs to.
- Opening dates should not be stated until officially announced by the
  Badrinath-Kedarnath Temple Committee.
